verdict.rationale: Evidence covers call summaries, extraction categories, transcripts, CLI, MCP, and SIP/telephony features, but nothing describes live-call monitoring dashboards, real-time observability, or alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. No mention of metrics, alert thresholds, webhooks for anomaly detection, or a monitoring console for platform engineers. Missing for 10: real-time monitoring dashboard, alerting/notification system for errors or misbehavior, error-rate tracking, on-call/integration with observability tools.
